depth_note: Tests building a complete trip budget across gas, food, and lodging

depth_note: Tests foreign currency exchange timing and method optimization

depth_note: Tests card selection strategy for international travel

depth_note: Tests break-even math on a high annual fee card

depth_note: Tests valuing time savings against a fixed government fee

depth_note: Tests booking-timing strategy with price tracking tactics

depth_note: Tests total-cost comparison for group lodging with hidden fees

depth_note: Tests fee-structure analysis that flips the obvious choice

depth_note: Tests comparing bundled vs itemized vacation pricing honestly

depth_note: Tests uncovering the real total cost behind an advertised fare

depth_note: Tests comprehensive multi-day theme park budgeting for a family

depth_note: Tests valuing a paid skip-the-line add-on against time and crowds

depth_note: Tests building a winter sports trip budget with lift tickets and gear

depth_note: Tests break-even analysis on sports equipment for infrequent use

depth_note: Tests net-proceeds comparison accounting for tax credits and hassle
